drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is our complete proposed draft for discussion. Base Salary and Severance Amount remain bracketed pending your client’s authorization; no terms are agreed. We have proposed payment, benefits, governing-law, and geographically and activity-limited non-compete terms for your review.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS. The Executive’s annual base salary shall be $[Base Salary to be confirmed], payable in substantially equal installments under the Company’s regular payroll practices, subject to applicable withholding. During employment, the Executive may participate in the Company’s employee benefit plans on the same terms as similarly situated executives, subject to each plan’s terms and eligibility requirements. The Company shall reimburse reasonable business expenses incurred in performing the Executive’s duties in accordance with its written expense policy.
edits.name: Compensation and benefits

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, the Company shall pay the Executive $[Severance Amount to be confirmed], less applicable withholding, in substantially equal installments over twelve months beginning on the first regular payroll date after the Executive signs, and does not revoke, a customary release of employment-related claims within 60 days after termination. Any payment otherwise due before the release becomes effective shall be paid on that first payroll date. For this section, “Cause” means the Executive’s fraud, willful misconduct, material breach of this Agreement, or conviction of a felony; for a breach capable of cure, Cause requires written notice and 30 days to cure. Accrued unpaid salary and vested benefits remain payable regardless of whether the Executive signs a release.
edits.name: Severance

edits.text: 4. NON-COMPETE; GOVERNING LAW. For twelve months after employment ends, the Executive shall not, within any U.S. state in which the Executive materially worked for the Company during the final twelve months of employment, perform duties substantially similar to the Executive’s Chief Operating Officer duties for a business that directly competes with a Company product or service for which the Executive had material responsibility during that period. Passive ownership of less than 2% of a publicly traded company is excluded. This restriction applies only to the extent permitted by applicable law. Delaware law governs this Agreement, without regard to conflict-of-laws rules, except where mandatory law requires otherwise.
edits.name: Non-compete and governing law
